method: CPU-only exact occupied-voxel-union boundary surfaces from scan 001 in its recorded NIfTI RAS+ millimetre frame. Preserve the source mask exactly; no smoothing, threshold changes, interpolation, decimation, vertex splitting or topology repair.

predictions_before_source_run.topology: Re-measure edge incidence and vertex links for every surface; preserve the source contact findings without repair.

purpose: Reproduce the original organ and major-vessel scan-001 geometry under the current compiler before comparing it with scan 002.
stopping_and_exclusion_rules: Freeze this source, compiler, runtime, scan, and label set before extraction.
Any identity, label-count, header, or occupancy-volume mismatch is a failed run and remains documented.

Topology is reported exactly as observed; results do not establish cross-scan registration, subject binding, expert segmentation accuracy, physical tissue volume ownership, mechanics, physiology, or clinical anatomy.
